integrity: Proof and reproducible finite checks are supplied. Finite checks do not establish the universal theorem. Self-review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite undirected cycles of unit metric edge lengths, positive vertex masses and conductances, real states, and \(1<p<\infty\). Sharpness is instantaneous. The \(p=2\) linear subcase is prior-method coverage; equivalent nonindexed nonlinear gradient results are not ruled out.
title: Sharp weighted-cycle \(p\)-heat gradient criterion and six-edge conductance rigidity
